title: Principal conversation and explicit team instructions
taskScope: Owner sees the principal conversation immediately and sends explicit orders to its selected native coordinator or other linked activity chats.

actors.name: Project owner
actors.goal: See activity personas and give an individual chat an order

preconditions: Authenticated owner Runtime with sealed keyring and selected execution/node
Trusted native binary and native SQLite directory configured in Runtime launcher
Existing native thread accepts read/resume without permission or provider overrides

failureContract.visibleError: This native request is blocked or its outcome is unobserved.
failureContract.safeStop: Keep each original request identity; do not repeat the batch or infer delivery.
prohibitedSideEffects: Native turns on opening the principal conversation
Automatic retries after partial or unknown delivery
Changing original chat history, working directory, permissions, provider or model
Graph assignment or output acceptance inferred from a reply

promises.statement: The principal conversation is visible beside the graph without opening Free canvas.
A visible next action names who receives a coordinator or team instruction.
An explicit owner order reaches only the selected native principal with a matching observed reply.
Each other linked persona gets its own immutable request identity and independently observed native reply.
Partial or unknown outcomes preserve identities and are reconciled without sending another turn.

outOfScope: Graph completion and accepted code output
